by
  let n := Nat.card Mˣ
  let G := Rˣ
  let H := Mˣ
  let χs := MulChar M R
  have h_finite_H : Fintype H := Fintype.ofFinite (Finite.ofSubtype (Finite M) (Subgroup.isSubgroup_unit M))
  have h_finite_χs : Fintype χs :=
    by apply Fintype.finite; exact (MulChar.finite M R).1
  let h_card_χs : Nat.card χs = Nat.card H :=
    by
      apply Eq.symm
      apply Nat.card_congr
      apply MulChar.char_group_isomorphic_to_units M R
  exact h_card_χs
